opening.argument: The trading records are the substance of this presentation. Viewers see trading charts, account-history rows and a performance claim of “PROFIT + 1701%” and “10 381 USD”; a separate signals profile displays trading metrics and charts. The description directs viewers to the forex platform, so this is promotional material centered on trading performance, not independent reporting or testing. The figures warrant scrutiny, but the available material does not show a guaranteed return, a payment request or a demonstrably false claim. On this record, promotion of a forex arbitrage platform is not itself evidence of a scam.
